Assassins.title: Deadly
Assassins.Description: Each PC may add +1 action rating to Hunt, Prowl, or Skirmish (up to a max rating of 3).

Assassins.title: Crow's Veil
Assassins.Description: Due to hard-won experience or occult ritual, your activities are hidden from the notice of the death-seeker crows. You don't take extra heat when killing is involved on a score.

Assassins.title: Emberdeath
Assassins.Description: Due to hard-won experience or occult ritual, you know the arcane method to destroy a living victim's spirit at the moment you kill them. Take 3 stress to channel electroplasmic energy from the ghost field to disintegrate the spirit and dead body in a shower of sparking embers.

Assassins.title: No Traces
Assassins.Description: When you keep an operation quiet or make it look like an accident, you get half the rep value of the target (round up) instead of zero. When you end downtime with zero heat, take +1 rep.

Assassins.title: Patron
Assassins.Description: When you advance your Tier, it costs half the coin it normally would. Who is your patron? Why do they help you?

Assassins.title: Predators
Assassins.Description: When you use stealth or subterfuge to commit murder, take +1d to the engagement roll.

Assassins.title: Vipers
Assassins.Description: When you acquire or craft poisons, you get +1 result level to your roll. When you employ a poison, you are specially prepared to be immune to its effects.

Bravos.title: Dangerous
Bravos.Description: Each PC may add +1 action rating to Hunt, Skirmish, or Wreck (up to a max rating of 3).

Bravos.title: Blood Brothers
Bravos.Description: When you fight alongside your cohorts in combat, they get +1d for teamwork rolls (setup and group actions). All of your cohorts get the Thugs type for free (if they're already Thugs, add another type).

Bravos.title: Door Kickers
Bravos.Description: When you execute an assault plan, take +1d to the engagement roll.

Bravos.title: Fiends
Bravos.Description: Fear is as good as respect. You may count each wanted level as if it was turf.

Bravos.title: Forged in the Fire
Bravos.Description: Each PC has been toughened by cruel experience. You get +1d to resistance rolls.

Bravos.title: Patron
Bravos.Description: When you advance your Tier, it costs half the coin it normally would. Who is your patron? Why do they help you?

Bravos.title: War Dogs
Bravos.Description: When you’re at war (-3 faction status), your crew does not suffer -1 hold and PCs still get two downtime activities, instead of just one.

Cult.title: Chosen
Cult.Description: Each PC may add +1 action rating to Attune, Study, or Sway (up to a max rating of 3).

Cult.title: Annointed
Cult.Description: You get +1d to resistance rolls against supernatural threats. You get +1d to healing rolls when you have supernatural harm.

Cult.title: Bound in Darkness
Cult.Description: You may use teamwork with any cult member, regardless of the distance separating you. By taking 1 stress, your whispered message is heard by every cultist.

Cult.title: Conviction
Cult.Description: Each PC gains an additional Vice: Worship. When you indulge this vice and bring a pleasing sacrifice, you don't overindulge if you clear excess stress. In addition, your deity will assist any one action roll you make—from now until you indulge this vice again.

Cult.title: Glory Incarnate
Cult.Description: Your deity sometimes manifests in the physical world. This can be a great boon, but the priorities and values of a god are not those of mortals. You have been warned.

Cult.title: Sealed in Blood
Cult.Description: Each human sacrifice yields -3 stress cost for any ritual you perform.

Cult.title: Zealotry
Cult.Description: Your cohorts have abandoned their reason to devote themselves to the cult. They will undertake any service, no matter how dangerous or strange. They gain +1d to rolls against enemies of the faith.

Hawkers.title: Silver Tongues
Hawkers.Description: Each PC may add +1 action rating to Command, Consort, or Sway (up to a max rating of 3).

Hawkers.title: Accord
Hawkers.Description: Sometimes friends are as good as territory. You may count up to three +3 faction statuses you hold as if they are turf.

Hawkers.title: The Good Stuff
Hawkers.Description: Your merchandise is exquisite. The product quality is equal to your Tier +2. When you deal with a crew or faction, the GM will tell you who among them is hooked on your product (one, a few, many, or all).

Hawkers.title: Ghost Market
Hawkers.Description: Through arcane ritual or hard-won experience, you have discovered how to prepare your product for sale to ghosts and/or demons. They do not pay in coin. What do they pay with?

Hawkers.title: High Society
Hawkers.Description: It's all about who you know. Take -1 heat during downtime and +1d to gather info about the city's elite.

Hawkers.title: Hooked
Hawkers.Description: Your gang members use your product. Add the savage, unreliable, or wild flaw to your gangs to give them +1 quality.

Hawkers.title: Patron
Hawkers.Description: When you advance your Tier, it costs half the coin it normally would. Who is your patron? Why do they help you?

Smugglers.title: Like Part of the Family
Smugglers.Description: Create one of your vehicles as a cohort (use the vehicle edges and flaws, below). Its quality is equal to your Tier +1.

Smugglers.title: All Hands
Smugglers.Description: During downtime, one of your cohorts may perform a downtime activity for the crew to acquire an asset, reduce heat, or work on a long-term project.

Smugglers.title: Ghost Passage
Smugglers.Description: From harsh experience or occult ritual, all crew members become immune to possession by spirits, but may choose to carry a second ghost as a passenger within their body.

Smugglers.title: Just Passing Through
Smugglers.Description: During downtime, take -1 heat. When your heat is 4 or less, you get +1d to deceive people when you pass yourselves off as ordinary citizens.

Smugglers.title: Leverage
Smugglers.Description: Your crew supplies contraband for other factions. Your success is good for them. Whenever you gain rep, gain +1 rep.

Smugglers.title: Reavers
Smugglers.Description: When you go into conflict aboard a vehicle, you gain +1 effect for vehicle damage and speed. Your vehicle gains armor.

Smugglers.title: Renegades
Smugglers.Description: Each PC may add +1 action rating to Finesse, Prowl, or Skirmish (up to a max rating of 3).

Shadows.title: Everyone Steals
Shadows.Description: Each PC may add +1 action rating to Prowl, Finesse, or Tinker (up to a max rating of 3).

Shadows.title: Ghost Echoes
Shadows.Description: From weird experience or occult ritual, all crew members gain the ability to see and interact with the ghostly structures, streets, and objects within the echo of Doskvol that exists in the ghost field.

Shadows.title: Pack Rats
Shadows.Description: Your lair is a jumble of stolen items. When you roll to acquire an asset, take +1d.

Shadows.title: Patron
Shadows.Description: When you advance your Tier, it costs half the coin it normally would. Who is your patron? Why do they help you?

Shadows.title: Second Story
Shadows.Description: When you execute a clandestine infiltration, you get +1d to the engagement roll.

Shadows.title: Slippery
Shadows.Description: When you roll entanglements, roll twice and keep the one you want. When you reduce heat on the crew, take +1d.

Shadows.title: Synchronized
Shadows.Description: When you perform a group action, you may count multiple 6s from different rolls as a critical success.
